newsitem.title: GERMANY: German network Kabel 1 says can expand programming.
newsitem.headline: German network Kabel 1 says can expand programming.

text.p: Private German network Kabel 1 said on Thursday that it has received permission from broadcasting authorities to increase the scope of its licence, allowing it to double its number of entertainment programmes.

The Bavarian State Centre for New Media (BLM) allowed Kabel 1, owned by Pro Sieben Media AG, to expand its programming, which it said will include documentaries and news shows as well as comedies and dramas in the first half of this year.
Kabel 1 head Ludwig Bauer said the expansion in programming would give the network "an extraordinary chance for growth".
As previously reported, the Pro Sieben group, which in 1996 posted record profits, plans to go public on the Frankfurt stock exchange later this year.
